candidates.change_summary: Change the require condition to allow anyone to call sudicideAnyone (removes ownership check), so selfdestruct can be invoked by any caller.
Invert the require condition so only non-owners can call sudicideAnyone, allowing non-owner callers to selfdestruct the contract while blocking the owner.
Remove the require check entirely so any caller can selfdestruct the contract.
Change selfdestruct to send funds to the stored owner instead of the caller, altering who receives ether on destruction.
Change the recipient of selfdestruct to the zero address, which will attempt to send funds to address(0) on destruction.
Flip the order: call selfdestruct first (which will end execution), then keep the require (unreachable), effectively allowing destruction without the check.
